label: The Chisa Thesis

floors.notes: OFF THE RECORD. Maxed in-game and never logged — the game keeps no history of past rotations, so teams and clocks are gone. Entered 10/17 on Andres's word.

lessons: This is the rotation of the 8/22 Hazard study (Sigillum + Fallacy of No Return, both Lv100 Calamity, behind a +15% all-attribute RES wall) — full write-up in docs/toa-hazard-area-effect-study.md. The floor-to-team mapping wasn't recorded, so the study lives here as a lesson instead of a floor row.
The support slot decided the floor, not the carry: every Chisa team landed near a 35s floor and every non-Chisa team near 65s, across three comps and two carries. S6 Aemeath lost 32s by dropping her.

Read what a buff is ATTACHED to, not how big the number is: the +50% Tune Strain bribe sat on the lane that finished last; the +30% Havoc Bane lane won because Bane carries an instant RES strip and DEF pen.
